effect.short: Held: Holder gains double effort values from battles, but has halved Speed in battle.
effect.long:
Held
:   When the holder would gain effort due to battle, it gains double that effort instead.

Held in battle
:   Holder has half its Speed.

effect.short: Held: Half the experience from a battle is split between Pokémon holding this item.
effect.long:
Held
:   Experience is split across two groups: Pokémon who participated in battle, and Pokémon holding this item.  Each Pokémon earns experience as though it had battled alone, divided by the number of Pokémon in its group, then divided by the number of groups. Pokémon holding this item who also participated in battle effectively earn experience twice.

    Fainted Pokémon never earn experience, and empty groups are
ignored; thus, if a single Pokémon is holding this item and the only Pokémon who battled faints from explosion, the holder will gain full experience.

effect.short: Held: Holder has a 3/16 (18.75%) chance to move first.
effect.long:
Held in battle
:   Whenever the holder attempts to use a move, it has a 3/16 chance to act first among moves with the same priority.  If multiple Pokémon have this effect at the same time, Speed is the tie-breaker as normal, but the effect of trick room is ignored.

effect.short: Held: Doubles the happiness earned by the holder.
effect.long:
Held
:   When the holder would earn happiness for any reason, it earns twice that amount instead.

effect.long:

effect.short: Held: Increases Attack by 50%, but restricts the holder to only one move.
effect.long:
Held in battle
:   Holder has 1.5× its Attack.  When the holder attempts to use a move, all its other moves are disabled until it leaves battle or loses this item.

    The restriction ends even if this item is swapped for another Choice item
via trick or switcheroo.

effect.short: Held: Damaging moves gain a 10% chance to make their target flinch. Traded on a Poliwhirl: Holder evolves into Politoed. Traded on a Slowpoke: Holder evolves into Slowking.
effect.long:
Held in battle
:   Holder’s damaging moves have a 10% chance to make their target flinch.  This chance applies independently to each hit of a multi-hit move.

    This item’s chance is rolled independently of any other move effects;
e.g., a move with a 30% chance to flinch normally will have a 37% total chance to flinch when used with this item, because 3% of the time, both effects activate.

Held by poliwhirl or slowbro
:   Holder evolves into politoed or slowking, respectively, when traded.

effect.long: Held: Damage from the holder’s moves is increased by 30%.  On each turn the holder uses a damage-inflicting move, it takes 10% its max HP in damage.

effect.long: Held: Whenever the holder uses a move that requires a turn to charge first (Bounce, Dig, Dive, Fly, Razor Wind, Skull Bash, Sky Attack, or Solarbeam), this item is consumed and the charge is skipped.  Skull Bash still provides a Defense boost.

effect.long: Held: Burns the holder at the end of each turn.

effect.long:
Held: Raises the holder’s Accuracy by 20% when it goes last.
Ingame description is incorrect.

effect.short: Held: Consectutive uses of the same attack have a cumulative damage boost of 10%. Maximum 100% boost.
effect.long: Held: Each time the holder uses the same move consecutively, its power is increased by another 10% of its original, to a maximum of 100%.

effect.short: Held: Holder’s Speed is halved. Negates all Ground-type immunities, and makes Flying-types take neutral damage from Ground-type moves. Arena Trap. Spikes, and Toxic Spikes affect the holder.
effect.long: Held: Decreases the holder’s Speed by 50%.  If the holder is Flying or has Levitate, it takes regular damage from Ground attacks and is suspectible to Spikes and Toxic Spikes.

effect.short: Held: Holder moves last in its priority bracket.
effect.long: Held: The holder will go last within its move’s priority bracket, regardless of Speed.  If multiple Pokémon within the same priority bracket are subject to this effect, the slower Pokémon will go first.  The holder will move after Pokémon with Stall.  If the holder has Stall, Stall is ignored.  This item ignores Trick Room.

effect.short: Held: Infatuates opposing Pokémon when holder is inflicted with infatuation.
effect.long: Held: When the holder becomes Attracted, the Pokémon it is Attracted to becomes Attracted back.

effect.short: Held: Poison-type holder recovers 1/16 (6.25%) max HP each turn. Non-Poison-Types take 1/8 (12.5%) max HP damage.
effect.long: Held: If the holder is Poison-type, restores 1/16 max HP at the end of each turn.  Otherwise, damages the holder by 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn.

effect.long: Held: The holder’s Hail will create a hailstorm lasting for eight turns rather than five.  As this item affects the move rather than the weather itself, the effect is not lost if the holder leaves battle or drops this item.

effect.short: Held: Sandstorm by the holder lasts 8 rounds instead of 5.
effect.long: Held: The holder’s Sandstorm will create a sandstorm lasting for eight turns rather than five.  As this item affects the move rather than the weather itself, the effect is not lost if the holder leaves battle or drops this item.

effect.long: Held: Increases the duration of the holder’s multiturn (2-5 turn) moves by three turns.

effect.short: Held: Increases Speed by 50%, but restricts the holder to only one move.
effect.long:
Held: Increases the holder’s Speed by 50%, but restricts it to the first move it uses until it leaves battle or loses this item.  If this item is swapped for another Choice item via Trick or Switcheroo, the holder’s restriction is still lifted, but it will again be restricted to the next move it uses.
(Quirk: If the holder is switched in by U-Turn and it also knows U-Turn, U-Turn becomes its restricted move.)

effect.long: Held: HP restored from Absorb, Aqua Ring, Drain Punch, Dream Eater, Giga Drain, Ingrain, Leech Life, Leech Seed, and Mega Drain is increased by 30%.  Damage inflicted is not affected.

Held: Increases the holder’s Special Attack by 50%, but restricts it to the first move it uses until it leaves battle or loses this item.  If this item is swapped for another Choice item via Trick or Switcheroo, the holder’s restriction is still lifted, but it will again be restricted to the next move it uses.
(Quirk: If the holder is switched in by U-Turn and it also knows U-Turn, U-Turn becomes its restricted move.)

effect.short: Held: Holder moves last in its priority bracket. Breeding: Snorlax begets a Munchlax Egg.
effect.long: Held: The holder will go last within its move’s priority bracket, regardless of Speed.  If multiple Pokémon within the same priority bracket are subject to this effect, the slower Pokémon will go first.  The holder will move after Pokémon with Stall.  If the holder has Stall, Stall is ignored.  This item ignores Trick Room.

effect.long: Held: Doubles the money the trainer receives after an in-game trainer battle.  This effect cannot apply more than once to the same battle.

effect.short: Held: Raises the holder’s critical hit ratio by one stage. Held by a Sneasel while levelling up at night: Holder evolves into Weavile.
effect.long:
Held: Raises the holder’s critical hit counter by 1.
Held by Sneasel: Evolves the holder into Weavile when it levels up during the night.

effect.short: Held: Damaging moves gain a 10% chance to make their target flinch. Held by a Gligar while levelling up: Holder evolves into Gliscor.
effect.long:
Held: When the holder attacks with most damaging moves, provides an extra 11.7% (30/256) chance for the target to flinch.
Held by Gligar: Evolves the holder into Gliscor when it levels up.
